name: popsicle
headline: WhatsDesk - WhatsApp Marketing Automation
short_description: WhatsDesk is an open-source WhatsApp marketing and automation platform. It helps businesses manage conversations, contacts, and campaigns. It connects to WhatsApp API for direct messaging and integrates with marketing workflows.
author: mobidonia

sections.overview:
WhatsDesk is an open-source WhatsApp marketing and automation platform that enables businesses to manage conversations, contacts, and campaigns directly through WhatsApp. Built on Laravel with WhatsApp Cloud API integration, it supports text and media messaging, WhatsApp calls, contact management, and basic campaign workflows. The platform includes multi-user support, webhook handling, analytics, and a REST API for extended functionality. Businesses use WhatsDesk to streamline customer communication, automate messaging workflows, and track campaign performance without relying on proprietary SaaS solutions.
Send bulk marketing messages and campaigns via WhatsApp to customer lists
Manage customer conversations and contacts in a centralized dashboard
Automate WhatsApp messaging workflows with webhooks and triggers
Track message delivery, engagement, and campaign analytics
- **Business**: GreenThumb Nursery
- **Industry**: Horticulture & Landscaping
- **Target Segment**: Local homeowners aged 30-55
- **Campaign Type**: Seasonal Promotion
- **Objective**: Drive sales of spring plants and gardening accessories
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mobidonia/whatsdesk`
